name: Old Town Station
demographics: Old Town Station attracts a diverse demographic mix from Burleson and surrounding Johnson County communities, primarily serving middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000+. The trade area draws young professionals, established families with children, and active retirees who appreciate the upscale dining and professional services offered. Visitors typically seek quality dining experiences and convenient access to professional office space, with shopping patterns reflecting a preference for experiential retail over traditional shopping. The center serves as a community gathering place for Burleson residents seeking an elevated suburban lifestyle experience.
description: Old Town Station is an upscale shopping center located in the heart of Burleson, Texas, offering a distinctive blend of dining, retail, and professional services. Situated at 295 East Renfro Street, this lifestyle destination has established itself as a premier gathering place for the community, featuring popular restaurants including Rio Mambo, The Rim, Old South Pancake House, and Fish City Grill. The center has recently expanded its offerings to include Regus office space, providing freshly remodeled executive suites and small offices with top-floor views, making it an ideal location for professionals seeking premium workspace in Burleson. Open 24 hours depending on individual shop and restaurant schedules, Old Town Station provides flexibility and convenience for visitors throughout the day and evening. With its combination of quality dining options, professional amenities, and community-focused atmosphere, Old Town Station represents the evolution of suburban retail into a true lifestyle center that serves both the practical and social needs of the Burleson community.
summary: Old Town Station is an upscale lifestyle center in Burleson, Texas, featuring popular dining destinations like Rio Mambo, Fish City Grill, and Old South Pancake House, along with newly remodeled Regus office space. This community-focused center serves as a premier gathering place offering quality restaurants and professional services in the heart of Burleson.
